# ADR-0094 · Chunk size for streaming uploads, revised

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Date:** 2026-09-07
- **Kind:** Policy
- **Decision:** OPT-2 — 256 KiB
- **Assumes:** [ADR-0093 · Chunk size for streaming uploads](ADR-0093-superseded-record.md)

## Question

How large is one streamed chunk, now that uploads are bounded?

## Decision

**OPT-2** — 256 KiB

Reversibility: reversible

## Options considered

|  | Option | Reversibility |
|---|---|---|
| OPT-1 | 64 KiB | reversible |
| **OPT-2** (chosen) | 256 KiB | reversible |

### OPT-1 · 64 KiB

- **D-1** — Small

### OPT-2 · 256 KiB (chosen)

- **D-1** — Bounded by the size cap anyway

What every option was judged against.
